The Maverick Standard

Most of what goes wrong on a job
goes wrong before anyone picks up a tool.

We look before we price

A phone quote is a guess. We come out, measure, open up what needs opening, and price the job we actually found — not the job we hoped for.

The scope is written down

Line by line: what's included, what isn't, and what we'd flag as a risk. If we think your budget is wrong for the work, we say so before you sign.

You hear it from us first

Older houses hide things. When we find one, you hear about it the same day, with what it changes and what it costs — before we carry on.

How a project runs

Four steps. No surprises in the middle.

  1. 01

    We come and look

    A real site visit, not a phone quote. Measurements, existing conditions, photographs, and an honest conversation about what the work actually involves.

  2. 02

    You get a written scope

    A line-by-line scope and price. What is included, what is not, and what we would flag as a risk before anyone signs anything.

  3. 03

    We build it

    Permits pulled where they are required. A crew that shows up, protects the rest of your house, and tells you when something changes.

  4. 04

    We finish it

    Punch list closed out, site cleaned, and a walkthrough before we call it done. If something is wrong afterwards, you call us.

Straight answers

Questions we get asked

What areas do you work in?

We are based in Lancaster and work across Worcester County and Central Massachusetts, and further for larger projects. If you are not sure whether we cover your town, call and ask.

Do you charge for an estimate?

No. We come and look at the project, take measurements and photographs, and send a written scope and price.

Are you licensed and insured?

Yes. Maverick City Builders is fully licensed in Massachusetts as a Home Improvement Contractor and Construction Supervisor, and carries insurance.

Do you pull permits?

Yes, on any work that requires them. Permitting is part of the scope we quote, not a surprise added later.

How long does a kitchen or bathroom take?

It depends on the scope and on what we find once the walls are open. We give you a schedule with the written scope, and we tell you as soon as anything changes it.
